title: Large personal CPC/ST/DOS language and application recovery discovery
summary: Personally screen 864 candidate URLs and add 15 projects, with nine explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root personally searched 12 GitHub query routes, screened 864 unique URLs and inspected 24 pinned repository trees. Fifteen additions and nine explicit non-promotions. Includes CPC language recovery, Atari ST application/scenery formats and DOS semantic restoration; distinguishes original-source ports, matching fragments, partial disassembly, derived formats and machine-level translation. No upstream game, compiler, installer, emulator or hardware program executed.

sources.reason: Readable behavioral reconstruction of lower firmware and upper Locomotive BASIC 1.0 ROMs. Registers become parameters, flags become typed results; original RAM addresses retained for PEEK/POKE. Inspected arithmetic/accumulator semantics.
GAC adventure database extraction/decompilation, editable source, compiler and native target interpreters. Inspected original CPC/Spectrum table locations and graphics database recovery in deGAC.py.

Published assembly adapted to exact original build, semantic C translation and portable C tree. Inspected structured copying/moving operations and original data-buffer layout, not automatic instruction dispatcher.
Native C99 port of author-preserved Quick Find with bounded archive directory readers. Inspected format dispatch and explicit ZIP64/RAR5/encrypted-header limitations.
Exploratory scenery instruction decoder with typed coordinate, conditional branch and table records. Inspected Haskell parser and documented original ST variable offsets.
Byte-level sequencer file documentation for headers, pattern pointers, six-byte events, quantization and time-signature/tempo changes. Inspected pattern event specification.
Seven original-style Pascal routines, sixteen packed layouts and six C routines alongside 215 procedure exports. Inspected reconstructed signed 16-bit friction/checksum and facade limits.
Borland C++ 3.1/Worx reconstruction using compile/disassemble comparisons. Inspected 290-byte picture-buffer initialization recovery with cross-module calls and original target identifiers.
Routine-by-routine browser port from TP7 executable, with source offsets, structured generator control flow and original pixel-collision VRAM model. Inspected RNG/graphics and procedure translations.
Three substantial episode listings with recovered runtime/game identities, symbol notes and annotated segmented references. Inspected Jill 1 startup assembly and shared symbol structures.
Old-RAR reader/writer implements legacy headers, Unpack15, password cipher, solid/multivolume and SFX detection. Inspected typed archive/header structures and original format flags.
English ALPHA_E.COM loader analysis plus CC1 extraction/decompression and 16-bit replacement starter. Inspected loader-related C++ with explicit emulated-register structure.
New C++20 Pizza Tycoon engine based on gameplay observation, original asset parsing and disassembled DOS study. Inspected structured bank conversation/state transitions.
Structured fighter/animation/rules port follows OpenOMF reverse-engineered behavior; inspected HAR module and architecture. Original file parsers separate from new WebGL2/Tauri host.
Hand-decompiled Borland Pascal 7 DOS text quest port. Inspected single-page structured game logic and original offset/record-size annotations, not original DOS binary wrapper.
Source is Acorn Archimedes ARM, explicitly not Amiga despite ADF extension; static recompilation recipe also outside semantic native-source focus.
Homage with own landscape generator and modern presentation; original binary/source-derived algorithm recovery not established by reviewed implementation claims.
Modern RP2350 GEM/pTOS desktop and real-time environment, not a recovered historical game/application for this focused pass.
Explicit mechanical 8086 instruction-to-C translation with machine-state equivalence; preserve architecture audit rather than classify as semantic recovered application.
Current CAD application source is substantive, but reviewed evidence does not establish the historical DOS/ST application recovery relationship requested here. No inferred origin from search match.
Port of a contemporary JUCE plugin inspired by Paula; not original Amiga sampler source recovery.
Current PSP port derives from Andy51 Motorola phone remake. Bundled original Amiga files do not establish recovery of Amiga algorithms.
Original-resource Java remake with deliberately original AI and altered neutral defenses; reviewed source provenance does not establish recovered original algorithms.
Generic heuristic DOS MZ pseudocode tool, not a concrete historical game/application reconstruction. Compiler/runtime pattern assumptions need target-backed evidence before broader claims.
